template_management_description: Template management will allow you to create, save, and apply shift demand patterns across different time periods. This feature includes template creation from existing data, manual template editing, and intelligent application with conflict resolution.
no_templates_description: Create your first template to save and reuse shift demand patterns.
choose_template_from_list: Choose a template from the list on the left to view its details.
standard_template_usage_info: This standard template will apply the same weekly pattern throughout the selected date range.
even_odd_template_usage_info: This even/odd template will alternate between even and odd week patterns based on ISO week numbers.
template_creation_description: The template creation interface will allow you to create new templates from scratch or existing demand patterns.
template_application_description: The template application interface will allow you to apply templates to specific date ranges with conflict resolution.
template_editor_description: The template editor will allow you to create and modify template demand patterns with an intuitive grid interface.
select_template_description: Choose a template from the list on the left to view its details and make edits.
confirm_delete_template: Are you sure you want to delete the template "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
template_name_too_short: Template name must be at least 3 characters
template_description_placeholder: Enter a description for this template (optional)
build_from_demands_explanation: Copy shift demands from any existing week to a week in this template. The target week will be completely overwritten.
select_source_week_explanation: Select any date - we'll find the Monday of that week and copy all shift demands from that week.
select_target_week_explanation: Choose which week in the template should be updated with the source week's demands.
any_day_will_find_monday: Any day in the week works - we'll find the Monday automatically
overwrite_warning: This will completely overwrite all existing demands in Week {{weekNumber}} of the template.
please_select_source_week: Please select a source week date
failed_to_apply_demands_to_template_week: Failed to apply demands to template week
confirm_delete_week_message: Are you sure you want to delete Week {{week}}? This will remove all demand data for this week.
build_from_demands_placeholder_info: This feature is coming soon! It will allow you to build or update templates from existing shift demand data.
select_date_range_feature: Select a date range with existing shift demands
preview_existing_demands_feature: Preview existing demand patterns in that range
select_shifts_to_include_feature: Select which shifts to include in the template
choose_template_type_feature: Choose between standard or even/odd template patterns
update_template_with_demands_feature: Update template "{{name}}" with the selected demand patterns
build_from_demands_placeholder_descripti: This will provide a powerful way to quickly create templates based on real scheduling data from your organization.
even_odd_conversion_warning: Converting to Even/Odd will automatically adjust the template to exactly 2 weeks. Weeks beyond the second will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
weeks_will_be_deleted: The following weeks will be deleted:
even_odd_weeks_fixed: Even/Odd templates always have exactly 2 weeks
template_type_constraints_violated: Template constraints not met for selected type
even_odd_requires_two_weeks: Even/Odd templates must have exactly 2 weeks
week_delete_warning: All demand data will be permanently lost
even_odd_template_explanation: Even/Odd templates use 2 weeks: one for even ISO weeks and one for odd ISO weeks.
insufficient_weeks_for_even_odd: Cannot convert: template needs at least 2 weeks
even_odd_adding_weeks: Converting to Even/Odd will add {{count}} week(s) to reach exactly 2 weeks
even_odd_removing_weeks: Converting to Even/Odd will remove {{count}} week(s) to keep exactly 2 weeks
